rationale: Pratik and Kaushik both work at the intersection of machine learning and systems-level implementation, with complementary expertise that could unlock deeper projects. Pratik's focus on LLM inference, language model training, and sparse autoencoders pairs well with Kaushik's hands-on robotics and embedded systems background—both share Python as a core tool and could explore how modern ML techniques apply to robotics and autonomous systems.
intro_message: Pratik Doshi, meet Kaushik Prakash — you're both ML engineers who bridge research and real-world systems (LLM inference + robotics), and could collaborate on applying cutting-edge ML to embedded or autonomous applications.
